notes.title: Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True~ (HD Remake) 1.0.7 Patch Notes - 3/27/2020
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Available to open the option during the game ("D" on keyboard / "View" button on Xbox One controller)
[*]Fixed the problem that occurred when opening the option
[*]Overall adjustment on Uzu's facial expressions
[*]Fixed the problem that sometimes occurred when clicking the right mouse on the selection
[*]Corrected the price of "Rest" in the schedule
[*]Fixed the keyboard control issue when repurchasing items from the wandering peddler
[*]Improvements on progressing the schedule. (Press F3 for High-Speed Mode)
[*]Overall adjustment on the drunkard event
[*]Added BGM PLAY mode in the options
[/list]
We will do our best about fixing bugs and reacting feedback to make you play comfortable "Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True~ (HD Remake)". Thank you.
